source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Click tab "Dashboard"
And also enter "Server Health" -> "Sensor Reading"

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor Reading & Threshold is human reable and match with spec.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sensor get 'STATUS_PSU1~6' 2>&1; echo ---SDR-FALLBACK---; ipmitool -I lanplus -C 17 -H "$BMC_IP" -U "$BMC_USER" -P "$BMC_PASS" sdr elist 2>&1 | head -100
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: returns FULL raw `ipmitool (OOB lanplus) sensor get "<SENSOR>"` reading + threshold; user judges (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES queries a literal six-slot range and cannot establish any individual PSU status record. It omits fitted population, FRU/slot/feed mapping, vendor/model bit definitions, simultaneous and latched conditions, UI summarization and active/standby semantics.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED correctly requires six separate reads, model-specific decoding and current load/redundancy context without fault injection. V3.1 additionally requires serial/feed identity, mixed-model decoder selection, explicit N/A handling and a documented relation to the two CRPS status points.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 905/2291 accepts the shorthand as a command and states no risk, without verifying six-channel coverage, raw bit provenance, latch/freshness, composite UI state or protected credential use.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Wistron-BMC-00090-V003 is a physical PSU remove/insert case with status-versus-temperature conflict and an unrelated reboot duplicate; its engineering decision remains separate and does not authorize service here. STATUS_CRPS1~2 may be a pair of aggregate or controller-level states, and PWR_PSU1~6 is numeric power rather than status coverage.

original_test_intent: Verify `STATUS_PSU1` through `STATUS_PSU6` are the complete Project-defined per-slot PSU status records and that each fitted or intentionally unfitted slot is mapped and decoded correctly from raw BMC/PMBus conditions into Dashboard and Server Health > Sensor Reading for the current redundancy configuration.
original_method: Inventory six physical positions, bind every exact status channel to a PSU FRU/serial, AC feed and PMBus source, then passively capture raw standard/OEM status and unchanged UI state separately for each slot. Apply the correct model decoder and state-specific fitted/unfitted/active/standby rules without creating a fault.
manual_activity: The PSU/platform owner confirms the fitted six-slot population, serial/feed mapping, model-specific status decoders and expected redundancy roles. Automation can collect passive raw BMC/PMBus and UI evidence; a person decides N/A and composite-fault interpretation and owns the formal per-slot result. No PSU manipulation is permitted by this row.
required_inputs: Chassis/power-backplane PN/revision, BMC build and six STATUS_PSU versus two STATUS_CRPS architecture
For slots 1-6: fitted state, FRU PN/serial/model/firmware, rated power, AC feed and active/standby/hot-spare/redundancy role
Per-model PMBus bus/address/page and STATUS_WORD/STATUS_BYTE/substatus/OEM register definitions with bit polarity
Stable SDR/API/UI identities and raw-to-decoded simultaneous state/event mapping
Composite-state precedence, latch/sticky history, clear ownership, BMC polling, UI propagation and freshness rules
Expected normal, unfitted, off, standby, degraded, failed, redundancy-lost, communication-lost, unavailable and stale states
Protected ipmitool/API/browser path and pinned reviewed `sensor.git` revision/checksum or approved manual collection
safety_requirements: Preserve SEL, PMBus fault history, BMC and PSU logs; latched bits may be the only evidence of an intermittent fault.
Never send `STATUS_PSU1~6` as one sensor name. Enumerate six exact slot records and bind each to FRU serial and feed before decoding.
Do not assume all six slots are fitted or homogeneous, and do not apply one vendor/model decoder to a different PSU revision without approval.
Do not substitute top-level CRPS health, numeric power or an overall `OK` icon for raw per-slot status; retain concurrent standard and OEM bits.
Do not remove/reseat a PSU, switch feeds, change load/redundancy/hot-spare mode, reset/clear a PSU, inject a fault, write a register or flash firmware. The dynamic case is separately unresolved.
Use secret-safe complete collection; do not expose `-P`, assume cipher 17, truncate output, run the inaccessible Script or automatically retry a missing/stale/faulted channel.
agent_execution_scope: Verify six-slot population, FRU/feed/status-source map, correct decoder for each model, current redundancy roles, protected tool and reference revision; build a six-row expectation matrix.

Read all required exact status records and supported PMBus/BMC fields with raw bits/strings, simultaneous decoded conditions, event masks, latch/history/freshness and timestamps; capture exact unchanged UI rows.
Record presence, role/share, feed health and related power only as context, then compare each fitted or intentionally unfitted slot to its approved state and UI mapping.
Return complete raw/redacted evidence without log or fault clear, PSU/feed/load/redundancy/reset/register/firmware mutation, automatic retry or DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve all six slot-to-FRU/feed/PMBus/SDR/UI mappings, any allowed mixed-model population and the relationship to STATUS_CRPS1~2.
Supply each applicable standard/OEM decoder, composite-state precedence, latch/freshness behavior and fitted/unfitted/role-specific acceptance; approve the evidence interface or override.
Review every required slot independently and issue the formal verdict without substituting aggregate health, power values or unexecuted remove/insert behavior.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unfit because IPMI does not expand this tilde shorthand and one response cannot prove six slot-bound, model-decoded records. Its fallback can omit channels, exposes the password and assumes cipher support while losing raw PMBus/OEM detail.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate complete FRU/SDR/PMBus inventory, resolve six exact status records, preserve raw standard/OEM fields and correlate each decoded condition with the serial-bound slot and matching UI timestamps over protected read-only access.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: STATUS_PSU1~6, both UI paths, source Criteria, generic clear wording, Script, DeepSeek command and 1/0-minute estimates remain preserved; Review expands the scope without editing Master or stimulating a PSU event.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a six-slot status matrix keyed by FRU serial, model, feed and redundancy role; collect full PMBus standard/OEM words, SDR/API and UI at aligned times, decode simultaneous conditions and apply per-model fitted-state rules.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The precise six-slot power-backplane and BMC/PSU status implementation documented by the Project.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record chassis/backplane, BMC/SDR/WebUI, every PSU model/firmware, PMBus client and Script versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project slot/feed/redundancy map, each PSU vendor PMBus Application Note or firmware status specification, BMC SDR/event map and WebUI state schema.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Expands the shorthand to six serial-bound slots and verifies raw-to-decoded composite status and UI fidelity while retaining passive observation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A passive snapshot does not validate removal/insertion, AC loss, failover, redundancy changes, fault assertion/deassertion, latch clearing, recovery or power accuracy.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Six-slot inventory, model-specific raw decoders, current-role acceptance, latch/freshness policy and validated evidence path.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Mixed PSU models may encode OEM bits differently; hot-spare and unfitted slots can legitimately differ, while UI summaries may hide multiple simultaneous conditions.

project_override_considerations: Redfish/OEM or vendor PMBus collection may be approved instead of ipmitool only if the original method, reason and engineer approval remain recorded and all six required slots retain equivalent FRU/feed identity, raw conditions, decoded state, event/latch behavior and freshness. STATUS_CRPS, PWR_PSU or an overall health aggregate is not automatically equivalent.
expected_evidence: Chassis/power-backplane/BMC identity and approved six-slot fitted/mixed-model/redundancy population plus STATUS_PSU-to-CRPS relationship
Per-slot FRU PN/serial/model/firmware/feed/role and PMBus bus/address/page/register plus stable SDR/API/UI identity matrix
Complete raw standard/OEM status fields, simultaneous decoded conditions, event masks, latch/history/freshness and synchronized timestamps with redacted UI rows
Explicit fitted/unfitted/off/active/standby/hot-spare/degraded/fault/redundancy-lost/unavailable/stale comparison under recorded feed/load context
Protected tool/Script provenance, preserved fault history, no-service/no-reset-or-fault-injection/no-retry proof, final PSU/BMC health and engineer-owned six-slot verdict

comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on the hybrid result and strengthens mixed-model, OEM-bit, simultaneous-state, latch/freshness and CRPS-separation requirements.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces command-existence reasoning with complete six-slot raw/decode/UI/state evidence.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No invalid draft exists for this exact passive source identity.

review_improvement: Prevents a failed range, wrong slot/feed, mixed-model decoder error, hidden composite fault or valid hot-spare/unfitted state from being presented as six passing status records, and prevents passive viewing from causing PSU service.
independent_technical_reasoning: Per-slot PSU status can combine PMBus standard and OEM words, with model-specific meanings, multiple simultaneous conditions and sticky history. Six physical positions may not all be populated or identical. Evidence must therefore be FRU- and feed-bound, preserve raw bits and decoder revision, and interpret the current redundancy role rather than rely on a generic green UI summary.
